# The Times Herald

> > The Times Herald is a local news organization serving Norristown, PA and surrounding Montgomery County communities with breaking news, sports coverage, weather, and community information.

The Times Herald provides comprehensive coverage of Norristown, Pennsylvania and the greater Montgomery County region, including local news, high school and professional sports (particularly Philadelphia teams), weather updates, and community events. The site serves residents across multiple Pennsylvania counties including Allegheny County and features coverage of local institutions like PIAA and NASD.

## Key Topics

## Core Content

- [The Times Herald Homepage](https://www.timesherald.com): Times Herald homepage for Norristown, PA local news, breaking news, sports, and weather
- [Sports](https://www.timesherald.com/sports): Sports news covering Philadelphia teams, high school sports, and Montgomery County athletics
